question: Which building fills the air-base role under BlackICE GitHub.

slots_noted.0xB78AB: Already recorded; this corrects the comment's claim about BlackICE.
slots_noted.0x16870D4: Already recorded; this revises the comment only.

addresses.name: CBuildingDataBase_RoleByModifierId
addresses.no_signature: a single instruction inside a larger function, not a function entry, so it has no calling convention of its own
addresses.comment: The building-role ladder in the building-database loader. eax = building->+0xC, the CModifier the building's one modifier key mapped to, then five compares of the modifier id at CModifier +0x24: 0x2E MODIFIER_AIR_CAPACITY -> db +0x1C, 0x2D MODIFIER_NAVAL_CAPACITY -> db +0x20, 0x4B MODIFIER_LOCAL_AA -> db +0x24, 0x0F MODIFIER_IC -> db +0x2C, 0x66 MODIFIER_LOCAL_UNDERGROUND -> db +0x28. In vanilla that is air_base, naval_base, anti_air, industry and underground. **In BlackICE GitHub (2026-11-19) the air-base slot is `fake_air_base`**: its `air_base` carries no modifier at all and `fake_air_base` carries `air_capacity = 1`; the other four are vanilla's (reversing/findings/FINDINGS-aifields.md, section 4). It is an if/else ladder with no break, so where two buildings carry the same modifier the last one parsed takes the slot. The defaults are set at rva 0xB769B, which points all five slots at the built-in 'nobuilding'.
addresses.evidence: BlackICE GitHub's common/buildings.txt as installed 2026-11-19: air_capacity on fake_air_base alone, air_base with no modifier key. Ireland1936_01_01_00.hoi3 of that mod: the AI's defend_prov lists leave out every province the history gives an air_base and no fake_air_base (Britain's 6159, France's 2251 and 4164, the Netherlands' 6500, Spain's 4910), and OpenHOI3 with the role by the modifier gives all 79 lists.
addresses.revises: comment - BlackICE GitHub's air-base role is fake_air_base, not air_base

addresses.name: g_CBuildingDataBase
addresses.comment:
The one `CBuildingDataBase`, 0x30 bytes, built lazily exactly as `g_CSubUnitDataBase` is: every user does `if (!g) g = new 0x30 bytes, init`. The init at rva `0x5BD30` is shared with 198 other databases and lays out the first 0x18 bytes - `+0x00`..`+0x0B` a name -> `CBuilding*` hash map (count at `+0x00`, `0x1FF` buckets at `+0x04`, the bucket array allocated and zeroed at `+0x08`) and `+0x0C`/`+0x10`/`+0x14` a `vector<CBuilding*>`. Everything from `+0x18` on is this class's own and the init does not touch it.

**Five of those six slots are cached `CBuilding*` for well-known roles**, filled by the loader at rva `0xB769B` (the defaults, all five pointed at the built-in 'nobuilding') and rva `0xB78AB` (the modifier ladder): `+0x1C` air_base, `+0x20` naval_base, `+0x24` anti_air, `+0x28` underground, `+0x2C` industry. The setup at `0x968B8`..`0x96A50` turns four of them into a province's building shortcuts,

    province->+0x308 = province->buildings[ db->+0x24->index ]
    province->+0x304 = province->buildings[ db->+0x1C->index ]
    province->+0x300 = province->buildings[ db->+0x20->index ]
    province->+0x30C = province->buildings[ db->+0x28->index ]

where `index` is `CBuilding +0x54` and `buildings` is `CProvince +0x310`.

**`+0x18` is the sixth slot and is dead.** It is the first dword the class adds on top of the shared 0x18-byte base, so it is a member rather than padding, but no instruction in the image writes or reads it: the init stops at `+0x14`, the loader's defaults set exactly the five role slots, and the ladder has exactly five branches. The object is `malloc`ed and never zeroed, so whatever stands at `+0x18` is heap garbage, not a building. **The slots hold whatever building carries the role's modifier**, so in BlackICE GitHub `+0x1C` is `fake_air_base` (CBuildingDataBase_RoleByModifierId).
addresses.evidence: BlackICE GitHub's common/buildings.txt as installed 2026-11-19: air_capacity on fake_air_base alone, air_base with no modifier key. Ireland1936_01_01_00.hoi3 of that mod: the AI's defend_prov lists leave out every province the history gives an air_base and no fake_air_base (Britain's 6159, France's 2251 and 4164, the Netherlands' 6500, Spain's 4910), and OpenHOI3 with the role by the modifier gives all 79 lists.
addresses.revises: comment - the slots follow the modifier
